what: Stations (floors · sections · items) are laid out within the scroll flow, and each time a station’s top edge crosses the 55% line of the screen, the content of the screen-fixed detail panel swaps with a .2s fade. The panel’s up/down buttons scroll to the neighboring station over 450ms cubic(.039,.365,.609,1). Over min(27.78vw,400px) before the first station, the panel’s progress f goes 0→1, with size pow(f,5)×.1+.9 and opacity pow(f,15), so it only appears sharply at the end. When the last station’s bottom edge passes the line, it unpins and rises with the page — a campus hero where floor intros swap as you descend a building cross-section

options.line: Baseline (% from top of screen), default 55
options.fade: Content split length (sec), default .2 — 0 means instant
options.dur: Button move duration (sec), default .45 — 0 means instant
options.from: Range (px) in which the panel appears, default min(27.78vw, 400px)
options.[data-fx-part=stop]: Stop — a spot within the flow. Inside <template> If present, replaces the panel body with that content. data-key goes to the element’s data-current
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Detail panel attached to the screen (required, position is set to fixed in the consuming css)
options.[data-fx-part=body]: Part of the panel that splits — whole panel if none
options.[data-fx-part=prev] · [data-fx-part=next: Up/down buttons (at the end, aria-disabled makes it .1)
options.fx:select: Fired at the element after its content is swapped — detail { index, stop }. Instead of the template you can take this and fill it in directly (e.g. re-applying the photo advance)
options.fx:go: Send a number in detail to take the user to that stop
